Utilities for the Anthropogenic Disturbance SpaDES Modules
text: wrapTerraList() writes disturbance list (vector layers grouped sector class) disk, unwrapTerraList() reads back: Given URL disturbanceList.zip instead, unwrapTerraList() downloads archive reproducible::prepInputs() extracts generalPath first. functions work disturbance list memory: harmonizeList() combines layers sector share class name; cleanupList() removes NULL empty elements; replaceLayers() replaces layers, sector class; extractNonPotentialLayers() lists sectors classes potential layers; disturbancePresenceRaster() maps layer present, using flattenTerra() collect layers nested list.
code: library(anthroDisturbanceUtils)  disturbanceList <- list(   mining = list(mining = terra::vect("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))", crs = "EPSG:3857")),   roads = list(roads = terra::vect("LINESTRING (0 0, 2 2)", crs = "EPSG:3857")) ) generalPath <- file.path(tempdir(), "disturbanceList")  wrapTerraList(disturbanceList, generalPath, zipFiles = TRUE) layers <- unwrapTerraList("theList.rds", generalPath)

title: Combine the layers of a disturbance list that share a class name — harmonizeList
code: square <- function(x) {   terra::vect(     sprintf("POLYGON ((%1$d 0, %2$d 0, %2$d 1, %1$d 1, %1$d 0))", x, x + 1),     crs = "EPSG:3857"   ) } disturbances <- list(   mining = list(claims = square(0), claims = square(2), potentialMining = square(4)) ) out <- harmonizeList(disturbances, whatNotToCombine = "potential") #> Harmonizing mining #> Returning mining merged. names(out$mining) #> [1] "potentialMining" "claims"          nrow(out$mining$claims) #> [1] 2

code: disturbanceList <- list(   mining = list(     mining = terra::vect("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))", crs = "EPSG:3857")   ),   roads = list(roads = terra::vect("LINESTRING (0 0, 2 2)", crs = "EPSG:3857")) ) generalPath <- file.path(tempdir(), "disturbanceList") index <- wrapTerraList(disturbanceList, generalPath) str(index) #> List of 2 #>  $ mining:List of 1 #>   ..$ mining: chr "mining_mining.rds" #>  $ roads :List of 1 #>   ..$ roads: chr "roads_roads.rds"  layers <- unwrapTerraList("theList.rds", generalPath) #> Recovering mining_mining.rds #> Recovering roads_roads.rds layers$roads$roads #> class       : SpatVector #> geometry    : lines #> dimensions  : 1, 0  (geometries, attributes) #> extent      : 0, 2, 0, 2  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) #> coord. ref. : WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator (EPSG:3857)

title: anthroDisturbanceUtils (development version)
text: helpers move anthropogenic disturbance modules. tests, Ronald Kilian, move . cleanupList() removes NULL empty elements disturbance list (anthroDisturbance_Generator). argument outter now outer. disturbancePresenceRaster() maps layer disturbance list present, flattenTerra() collects terra layers nested list (-CAST fork anthroDisturbance_Generator). extractNonPotentialLayers() lists sectors classes disturbance list potential layers (anthroDisturbance_Generator). none, returns empty table still two columns. harmonizeList() combines layers sector share class name (anthroDisturbance_DataPrep). Unlike module’s copy, return sector’s layers twice excluded classes repeat, whatNotToCombine = NULL combines every repeated class instead none. replaceLayers() replaces layers disturbance list, sector class. generalizes replaceList() potentialResourcesNT_DataPrep potentialResourcesYT_DataPrep, replaced four fixed layers.

title: anthroDisturbanceUtils 0.0.1
text: Initial version. archive writer reader anthropogenic disturbance modules move , modules share one copy (tati-micheletti/anthroDisturbance_DataPrep#8). unwrapTerraList() reads disturbance list back theList.rds disturbanceList.zip. looks layers generalPath, whatever directory index names, works terra attached (fixes tati-micheletti/anthroDisturbance_DataPrep#7, tati-micheletti/anthroDisturbance_Generator#5 tati-micheletti/potentialResourcesNT_DataPrep#5). wrapTerraList() writes disturbance list one .rds file per layer plus index theList.rds, optionally disturbanceList.zip. Layer files named sector class, random, index holds file names, full paths.
